scope: credential-free Quickstart discovery worker and generated OpenShift isolation bundle
claims: Only HTTPS GitHub Quickstart repositories at full commit SHAs with a separate, active controller-issued approval are accepted.
Payload, complete source files, and bounded output are scanned before a receipt is emitted.
The worker produces a fail-closed internal one-seat draft and cleanup receipt without live credentials.
The generated Job is non-root, read-only, tokenless, bounded, ephemeral, and default-deny.
The generated NetworkPolicy permits only OpenShift DNS and an in-cluster egress proxy.
non_claims: The certification worker image has not been signed, published externally, or paired with an SBOM.
The trusted dispatcher and receipt collector have not been deployed.
Timeout, cancellation, scanner-failure, and retry-recovery paths do not yet have complete live evidence.
The admin Run discovery action remains disabled.
